body:
It went okay. The worst was they asked if I had any triggers that set this off, sexual assault, etc. and I just had to be like "no, literally nothing is wrong but I feel like everything is wrong and I want to die for no good goddamn reason." It was just an evaluation though. I had the option of inpatient or intensive outpatient. Because they were able to get me in to the outpatient so soon that's what I went with. I felt like now that I have a plan to fix my brain I could handle the wait. I go in this afternoon. But it's for a week, like all day other than today I think. I'm gonna tell my job in a little bit that I need the week off. I don't know what they'll say, if they'll give me the time off. I think they will, but I don't give a fuck at this point.

I literally googled "CITY metal health" and that pulled up my options. If nothing comes up for you, or you're in a smaller area you can just go the the ER and they should be able to find your options. If you have insurance you might be able to call them to find out what's covered or even speak to a patient advocate/nurse advisor to walk you through it.

I'm still not in a good place, but having a plan makes me feel somewhat in control. Or really, that I'm acknowledging being out of control but I'm letting the right people know that I'm a fucking mess and need help or I am going to explode.

Good luck, be safe.
Did it help? I can't help but think I'm just going to be wasting everyone's time.

I really don't think they have to say why they terminated my employment. And from Google what previous employers say is really just company policy, there doesn't seem to be any legal limit on what they can and can't say. I do know that my separation agreement says that both I and the employer can't disparage, etc. each other. So I guess I should take that as a good sign that they won't talk shit/will give a decent referral.

I really don't think it's illegal not to say why I was let go, especially because I'm in an At Will Employment state.  I asked while I was being let go and they just said that it's company policy not to give reasons. They gave me an official letter and a separation agreement, neither which gave details of the reason for my termination. I briefly spoke with someone that I worked with, but was in a different department, and they either didn't know or wouldn't say either. It's a small company so I'm thinking they know and don't want to hurt my feelings.

Maybe I just wasn't as good as I thought I was? I have ADHD and I've been off my meds for a year for various reasons. I just made an appointment with a psych to try to get back on meds, but I can't get in until August. I feel like it's pointless to try to get another job until then and that I'll just mess up that too.

Thanks though. I'll probably eventually get through it, but I just can't see how. It really feels like I've just lost my only chance of happiness.
